Every vehicle named, what blocks what, the people queue, and each route played until it dies.

Tap a vehicle. Letters are colours (Y yellow, R red, G green, C cyan, B blue, P purple, M magenta, O orange, N brown, LP light pink); the number counts that colour.

Check the blocks

Tap a vehicle. Dashed band = its path to the edge. Red = blocks it. Green dashed ring = it frees these. Small green dot = you've checked it.

Fix mode: tap any vehicle on the board to add it to, or remove it from, 's blockers. Tap Fix blockers again when done.

Your fixes

Fixes are used straight away by Scenarios and Play on this device. Send me the copied text and I'll build them into the app.
